en.text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

zhSimplified.text: 提幔人以利法回答说：

zhTraditional.text: 提幔人以利法回答說：

en.text: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.

zhSimplified.text: 人岂能使 神有益呢？ 智慧人但能有益于己。

zhTraditional.text: 人豈能使上帝有益呢？ 智慧人但能有益於己。

en.text: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?

zhSimplified.text: 你为人公义，岂叫全能者喜悦呢？ 你行为完全，岂能使他得利呢？

zhTraditional.text: 你為人公義，豈叫全能者喜悅呢？ 你行為完全，豈能使他得利呢？

en.text: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?

zhSimplified.text: 岂是因你敬畏他 就责备你、审判你吗？

zhTraditional.text: 豈是因你敬畏他 就責備你、審判你嗎？

en.text: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.

zhSimplified.text: 你的罪恶岂不是大吗？ 你的罪孽也没有穷尽；

zhTraditional.text: 你的罪惡豈不是大嗎？ 你的罪孽也沒有窮盡；

en.text: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

zhSimplified.text: 因你无故强取弟兄的物为当头， 剥去贫寒人的衣服。

zhTraditional.text: 因你無故強取弟兄的物為當頭， 剝去貧寒人的衣服。

en.text: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.

zhSimplified.text: 困乏的人，你没有给他水喝； 饥饿的人，你没有给他食物。

zhTraditional.text: 困乏的人，你沒有給他水喝； 飢餓的人，你沒有給他食物。

en.text: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.

zhSimplified.text: 有能力的人就得地土； 尊贵的人也住在其中。

zhTraditional.text: 有能力的人就得地土； 尊貴的人也住在其中。

en.text: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

zhSimplified.text: 你打发寡妇空手回去， 折断孤儿的膀臂。

zhTraditional.text: 你打發寡婦空手回去， 折斷孤兒的膀臂。

en.text: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,

zhSimplified.text: 因此，有网罗环绕你， 有恐惧忽然使你惊惶；

zhTraditional.text: 因此，有網羅環繞你， 有恐懼忽然使你驚惶；

en.text: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.

zhSimplified.text: 或有黑暗蒙蔽你， 并有洪水淹没你。

zhTraditional.text: 或有黑暗蒙蔽你， 並有洪水淹沒你。

en.text: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!

zhSimplified.text: 神岂不是在高天吗？ 你看星宿何其高呢！

zhTraditional.text: 上帝豈不是在高天嗎？ 你看星宿何其高呢！

en.text: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?

zhSimplified.text: 你说： 神知道什么？ 他岂能看透幽暗施行审判呢？

zhTraditional.text: 你說：上帝知道甚麼？ 他豈能看透幽暗施行審判呢？

en.text: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’

zhSimplified.text: 密云将他遮盖，使他不能看见； 他周游穹苍。

zhTraditional.text: 密雲將他遮蓋，使他不能看見； 他周遊穹蒼。

en.text: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,

zhSimplified.text: 你要依从上古的道吗？ 这道是恶人所行的。

zhTraditional.text: 你要依從上古的道嗎？ 這道是惡人所行的。

en.text: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

zhSimplified.text: 他们未到死期，忽然除灭； 根基毁坏，好像被江河冲去。

zhTraditional.text: 他們未到死期，忽然除滅； 根基毀壞，好像被江河沖去。

en.text: who said to God, ‘Depart from us!’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’

zhSimplified.text: 他们向 神说：离开我们吧！ 又说：全能者能把我们怎么样呢？

zhTraditional.text: 他們向上帝說：離開我們吧！ 又說：全能者能把我們怎麼樣呢？

en.text: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

zhSimplified.text: 哪知 神以美物充满他们的房屋； 但恶人所谋定的离我好远。

zhTraditional.text: 哪知上帝以美物充滿他們的房屋； 但惡人所謀定的離我好遠。

en.text: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,

zhSimplified.text: 义人看见他们的结局就欢喜； 无辜的人嗤笑他们，

zhTraditional.text: 義人看見他們的結局就歡喜； 無辜的人嗤笑他們，

en.text: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’

zhSimplified.text: 说：那起来攻击我们的果然被剪除， 其余的都被火烧灭。

zhTraditional.text: 說：那起來攻擊我們的果然被剪除， 其餘的都被火燒滅。

en.text: “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.

zhSimplified.text: 你要认识 神，就得平安； 福气也必临到你。

zhTraditional.text: 你要認識上帝，就得平安； 福氣也必臨到你。

en.text: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.

zhSimplified.text: 你当领受他口中的教训， 将他的言语存在心里。

zhTraditional.text: 你當領受他口中的教訓， 將他的言語存在心裏。

en.text: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.

zhSimplified.text: 你若归向全能者，从你帐棚中远除不义， 就必得建立。

zhTraditional.text: 你若歸向全能者，從你帳棚中遠除不義， 就必得建立。

en.text: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.

zhSimplified.text: 要将你的珍宝丢在尘土里， 将俄斐的黄金丢在溪河石头之间；

zhTraditional.text: 要將你的珍寶丟在塵土裏， 將俄斐的黃金丟在溪河石頭之間；

en.text: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.

zhSimplified.text: 全能者就必为你的珍宝， 作你的宝银。

zhTraditional.text: 全能者就必為你的珍寶， 作你的寶銀。

en.text: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.

zhSimplified.text: 你就要以全能者为喜乐， 向 神仰起脸来。

zhTraditional.text: 你就要以全能者為喜樂， 向上帝仰起臉來。

en.text: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.

zhSimplified.text: 你要祷告他，他就听你； 你也要还你的愿。

zhTraditional.text: 你要禱告他，他就聽你； 你也要還你的願。

en.text: You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.

zhSimplified.text: 你定意要做何事，必然给你成就； 亮光也必照耀你的路。

zhTraditional.text: 你定意要做何事，必然給你成就； 亮光也必照耀你的路。

en.text: When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.

zhSimplified.text: 人使你降卑，你仍可说：必得高升； 谦卑的人， 神必然拯救。

zhTraditional.text: 人使你降卑，你仍可說：必得高升； 謙卑的人，上帝必然拯救。

en.text: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”

zhSimplified.text: 人非无辜， 神且要搭救他； 他因你手中清洁，必蒙拯救。

zhTraditional.text: 人非無辜，上帝且要搭救他； 他因你手中清潔，必蒙拯救。
